# Fabrique Numérique conventions

<!-- Generated by scripts/skills/generate.mjs from scripts/skills/config.json and the docs. Do not edit. -->

Pick the skill that matches the task, load it, and follow its links to the reference pages.

## Skills

- `fabnum-code-style`: naming (branches, commits, files, variables), TypeScript rules, code practices, lint and formatting.
- `fabnum-project-structure`: folder layout per project type, pnpm workspaces and Turborepo monorepos.
- `fabnum-rest-api`: route naming, logging, HTTP status codes and error responses of REST APIs.
- `fabnum-project-docs`: what the user and developer documentation of a project must contain, README and CONTRIBUTING.
- `fabnum-poc-to-prod`: the production-readiness checklist of an AI or fullstack project.
- `fabnum-deployment`: Docker images, Kubernetes security, Helm charts, Cloud Pi Native target.
- `fabnum-cicd`: pipeline phases and the reusable GitHub Actions workflows of dnum-mi/fabnum-cicd.
- `fabnum-stack`: recommended libraries and tools, ESLint, Prettier, Prisma, REST Client.
- `fabnum-server`: NestJS, Fastify and FastAPI project conventions.
- `fabnum-client`: Vue 3, Nuxt 3 with VueDsfr, and the toaster alert system.
